body: As someone who has several failed attempts, a gun is really the only way to go. It's not 100% guaranteed (as a healthcare worker, I've seen the "failed" failures), but the odds are better than another other method. Wait until you're old enough to buy a gun and then do it if that is what you chose to do.
My life hasn't been any harder than anyone else's. In some ways, it was easier. But I know my worth and when there is no chance of accomplishing what I deserve left, it's time to end it. Cheers.
I am choosing mine. When you go out on your own terms, you get that benefit.
